verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client app for triaging, reviewing and managing GitHub work, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples falls outside its product category. The GitHub REST and GraphQL API docs in the pack belong to the host platform, not the mobile app, and they do not describe interactive or runnable examples either. The openapi probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
